title: The Complete India Travel Guide for 2026
metaDescription: Plan the ultimate trip to India with our 2026 guide. Discover the best attractions, food, neighborhoods, and hidden gems.
excerpt: India is a destination that rewards the curious traveler. Beyond the well-known attractions lies a world of hidden gems and unforgettable experiences.
author: Wanderlust Team
content:
There is something about India that captures the imagination of travelers worldwide. For those planning a trip to India, this guide will show you the best of what awaits.

## Best Time to Visit

The ideal time to explore India depends on what you want to experience. Spring brings mild weather and blooming landscapes.

## Top Attractions

- Must-see sights that define India
- Hidden treasures only locals know about
- Cultural sites that tell the story of India
- Scenic lookouts for unforgettable photos

![India landscape](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1548013146-72479768bada?fm=webp&w=1200&q=60)

## Local Cuisine

No trip to India is complete without sampling the local food. From street-side vendors to fine dining establishments, the culinary scene reflects the region's rich heritage and innovative spirit.

## Getting Around

Walking is the best way to experience the true charm of India, with most major sights within easy reach.

## Where to Stay

Homestays are a great way to immerse yourself in local culture while visiting India.
